title: 概率最大的路径
summary: 无向图每条边有成功概率，求 start 到 end 路径概率乘积的最大值，不可达返回零。
insight: 把 Dijkstra 的距离最小化改为概率最大化：最大堆每次取当前概率最高节点，沿边乘概率松弛。概率不超过一保证已弹出的最优值不会被更差路径改进。
pitfalls: 图是无向的需添加双向边
路径概率为边概率乘积

solutions.title: 最大乘积 Dijkstra
solutions.idea: 用最大堆按当前路径概率从高到低扩展。
steps: 弹出 probability；小于 best[node] 则跳过，node==end 可返回
对每条边 candidate=probability*edgeProbability，若更大则更新并入堆

code.java: class Solution { public double maxProbability(int n,int[][] edges,double[] succProb,int start,int end){List<double[]>[] graph=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<edges.length;i++){graph[edges[i][0]].add(new double[]{edges[i][1],succProb[i]});graph[edges[i][1]].add(new double[]{edges[i][0],succProb[i]});}double[] best=new double[n];best[start]=1;PriorityQueue<double[]> heap=new PriorityQueue<>((a,b)->Double.compare(b[0],a[0]));heap.offer(new double[]{1,start});while(!heap.isEmpty()){double[] state=heap.poll();double probability=state[0];int node=(int)state[1];if(probability<best[node])continue;if(node==end)return probability;for(double[] edge:graph[node]){int next=(int)edge[0];double candidate=probability*edge[1];if(candidate>best[next]){best[next]=candidate;heap.offer(new double[]{candidate,next});}}}return 0;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxProbability(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,succProb:DoubleArray,start:Int,end:Int):Double{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<Pair<Int,Double>>()};for(i in edges.indices){graph[edges[i][0]].add(edges[i][1] to succProb[i]);graph[edges[i][1]].add(edges[i][0] to succProb[i])};val best=DoubleArray(n);best[start]=1.0;val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<Pair<Double,Int>>(compareByDescending{it.first});heap.add(1.0 to start);while(heap.isNotEmpty()){val(probability,node)=heap.remove();if(probability<best[node])continue;if(node==end)return probability;for((next,edgeProbability)in graph[node]){val candidate=probability*edgeProbability;if(candidate>best[next]){best[next]=candidate;heap.add(candidate to next)}}};return 0.0} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: double maxProbability(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,vector<double>& succProb,int start,int end){vector<vector<pair<int,double>>> graph(n);for(int i=0;i<(int)edges.size();++i){graph[edges[i][0]].push_back({edges[i][1],succProb[i]});graph[edges[i][1]].push_back({edges[i][0],succProb[i]});}vector<double> best(n);best[start]=1;priority_queue<pair<double,int>> heap;heap.push({1,start});while(!heap.empty()){auto [probability,node]=heap.top();heap.pop();if(probability<best[node])continue;if(node==end)return probability;for(auto [next,edgeProbability]:graph[node]){double candidate=probability*edgeProbability;if(candidate>best[next]){best[next]=candidate;heap.push({candidate,next});}}}return 0;} };
